transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... mostly it's just stuff at work. I'm a buyer, and... well, I just can't shake this feeling lately. It seems like people there, and maybe some of the vendors, are tracking my buys. Like they're... messing with the launch numbers just to make me look stupid. My supervisor keeps pulling up reports to show me that's not happening, but... I don't know. I guess that's what made me come in.

When your supervisor shows you those reports proving that the numbers haven't been manipulated, do you find that convincing, or do you still believe something suspicious is going on despite what the reports show?

Um... no. I mean, I see the reports he shows me, but... it doesn't really change anything. I still know they're tracking what I buy. The numbers on the paper don't mean they aren't messing with the launch just to... make me look bad. The reports don't prove anything.
Besides these beliefs about people tracking you at work, have you been hearing voices or seeing things that other people don't seem to notice?

Um... I mean... sometimes. Just... like if I'm in the stockroom, or driving back from a vendor meeting. I'll hear... a guy's voice. Like he's right behind me. He just says stuff like, 'Move faster, Scott,' or... he laughs at my picks. But when I turn around to look... there's nobody there. So... yeah. That's about it.
When did you first start hearing that man's voice in the stockroom—was that before you started noticing people tracking your work, or around the same time, or did the tracking concerns come first?
Um... I guess they kind of started around the same time. It's been... maybe ten months, roughly. Just... yeah, about ten months of both things happening.
Before these things started happening about ten months ago—the voice and the tracking concerns—were you functioning pretty normally at work and in your life?

Um... yeah, I guess. Before then, things were... fine. Normal. But... lately, things have kind of taken a hit. At work, I've... missed some buying deadlines. Made some impulsive calls on purchases that... well, it damaged some vendor relationships. My supervisor actually gave me a formal warning about it. And... I don't know. I just pulled away from my friends, too. I stopped showing up for our volleyball weekends... and those gallery nights I used to like. I just... I don't go anymore.

In those ten months since things started, have you had periods where you felt unusually energetic, needed much less sleep than normal, or felt like you could accomplish a lot more than usual—separate from the times when you were worried about people tracking you?

Um... yeah, I guess there was a time like that. I had this stretch where I... I didn't really need to sleep much. Felt like I could just... run the whole market, you know? But... even when that stopped, and I was sleeping normally again and not feeling so... wired... I still had a few weeks where I knew they were tracking my buys. And... I still heard that guy's voice in the stockroom. So... yeah. It didn't all just go away at once.
During that stretch when you didn't need much sleep and felt like you could run the whole market—did you also feel unusually happy or excited, or was it more just feeling energized and confident?

Um... I don't know. A mix, I guess. I'd get these stretches where it just felt like... like the whole city was opening up for me. But... it wasn't always a good mood. If someone questioned a purchase order, or... told me to slow down... I'd just snap. Way harder than I meant to. So... yeah.

When you were having that stretch where you didn't need much sleep and felt like you could run the whole market—during that exact same time period, were you also hearing that man's voice and believing people were tracking your buys?

Yeah... I was. Even when I was... you know, barely sleeping and talking a lot about sneaker trends... feeling like I couldn't mess up... I still thought the vendors were messing with the numbers. And... I still heard him. The voice. Just... telling me to move faster. So... yeah, it was all happening at once.
